title: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in updateUserRights…
description: phpMyFAQ versions from 4.2.0-alpha.2 up to but not including 4.2.0-RC.2 have an improper authorization vulnerability in the updateUserRights function. This flaw allows USER_EDIT administrators to escalate their privileges by removing category restrictions on group rights, effectively converting restricted group rights into global direct rights. As a result, attackers with USER_EDIT privileges can edit, publish, or delete FAQs in categories that should be withheld from them.
